bullets.title: Ultra-Slim Qi2-Compatible Magnetic Power Bank
bullets.text: At just 0.3 inches thin, this ultra-slim power bank suppots Qi2 certification and offers 5,000mAh of reliable wireless charging, perfect for daily carry and among the trusted iPhone power banks available.

bullets.title: Enhanced Safety and Speed
bullets.text: Experience high-speed charging with enhanced safety. Qi2 MagSafe compatibility, temperature protection, and up to 20W max USB-C output

bullets.title: 15W MagSafe-Compatible Charging
bullets.text: Get up to 15W max of Qi2-certified fast wireless charging — enough to power an iPhone 16 Pro to 25% in just 42 minutes. ( Note: Data based on internal lab testing; actual performance may vary.)

bullets.title: 104℉ for Safer Handling
bullets.text: Designed with graphene cooling, dual NTC chips, and smart heat control, the device stays below 104°F, 14 degrees cooler than industry standard for safer charging with temperature protection built in.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), USB-C to USB-C charging cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Supercharge with 100W Max
bullets.text: This remarkably compact charger delivers up to 100W power, quickly charging your 14-inch MacBook Pro to 50% in just 27 minutes.

bullets.title: The Little Charger That Excels
bullets.text: Enjoy the freedom of charging on the move with a charger that's tiny like the latest AirPods Pro and packs a serious power punch.

bullets.title: Locks In Place
bullets.text: At just 4.23 oz, Anker Nano Charger stays securely in place with durable matte prongs, offering stability without the weight.

bullets.title: Superior Safety
bullets.text: ActiveShield 2.0 Intelligently monitors temperature 3 million times per day and adjusts power output to safeguard your connected devices.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Nano Charger (100W) with 6 ft USB-C Cable, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Fast Charging Power Bank Made Easy
bullets.text: Get high-speed charging with a 22.5W output from the UBC-C port and enjoy the convenience of charging your phone up to 4 times.

bullets.title: Easy to Carry, Easier to Style
bullets.text: Featuring a built-in strap, this power bank ensures portability and convenient charging wherever you are with the sleek design too.

bullets.title: Power in Your Pocket
bullets.text: Discover the power of a 20,000mAh battery in a slim 14.07 × 7.17 × 2.77 cm design, fueling phones and tablets for days.

bullets.title: Trickle-Charging Mode
bullets.text: Keeps low-power devices like earbuds, smartwatches, and fitness bands safely charged with optimized, steady power.

bullets.title: ActiveShield 3.0 Safety
bullets.text: Over 6 million daily temperature checks ensure your device's protection.

bullets.title: Ready for Endless Use
bullets.text: Crafted for durability, the integrated bidirectional USB-C cable is tested to endure over 10,000 bends, ensuring it stands up to the rigors of everyday use.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Zolo Power Bank (20K, 22.5W, Built-In USB-C Cable), welcome guide.

31061.name: Nano Charger (35W, Built-In Retractable USB-C Cable)

bullets.title: Fast, Efficient, and Safe
bullets.text: Delivers a reliable charging solution that combines speed and safety with advanced smart technology.

bullets.title: Pocket-Friendly Charger
bullets.text: Equipped with a built-in retractable USB-C cable and a lightweight design, this charger is ideal for on-the-go use. Its refined cable mechanism is now compact enough to match the size of AirPods Pro (2nd generation), making it easy to slip into any pocket or bag.

bullets.title: Smart 35W Max Dual USB-C Power
bullets.text: Featuring dual USB-C ports with smart power distribution, this charger enhances charging efficiency and simplifies daily use by eliminating the need for multiple chargers.

bullets.title: Pull for Power and Convenience
bullets.text: The advanced charger incorporates the patented Anker InstaCord cable, built to endure 20,000 bends and 20,000 retractions for lasting durability. The adjustable cable extends up to 2.3 ft, offering flexibility to suit various charging scenarios. ( Note: Data based on internal testing. Actual performance may vary depending on specific usage conditions.)

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Nano Charger (35W, Built-In Retractable USB-C Cable), welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service

bullets.title: 220W Total Output Power
bullets.text: Keep your office setup running strong with 220W total output from two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.

bullets.title: Flight-Ready 20K Power
bullets.text: Carry 20,100mAh (72.36Wh) of portable, TSA-approved power, enough for up to 4.2 days of video streaming on an iPhone 17 Pro Max.

bullets.title: 140W Max Fast Charging
bullets.text: Delivers up to 140W high-speed output for fast laptop charging when connected to a 5A cable. Charge a 16″ MacBook Pro (M4 Pro) to 50% in 28 minutes.

bullets.title: High-Speed 100W Max Recharging
bullets.text: Recharge Anker Prime Power Bank to 50% in 25 minutes using the 100W max USB-C input.

bullets.title: What You Get
bullets.text: Anker Prime Power Bank (20K, 220W), 3.3 ft USB-C to USB-C charging cable (240W), travel pouch, welcome guide, 12-month warranty, and our friendly customer service.

bullets.title: Note
bullets.text: Data based on internal lab testing. Actual performance may vary depending on specific conditions of use.

bullets.title: 160 W power in air pods size
bullets.text: with a power thickness of 1.35 W/cm3, this slim USB-C charger with 3 ports delivers 160 W max. and is as compact as an AirPods Pro 3 case — easy to carry and ready for every need.

bullets.title: 140 W single port use
bullets.text: with 140 W max. On a port without throttling, you can charge laptops at maximum speed in any condition. No matter which port you use, you can use your 16-inch MacBook Pro in 25 minutes. to charge from 0% to 50%.

bullets.title: One for three
bullets.text: Thanks to intelligent power distribution with PowerI5.0, you can charge a 16-inch MacBook Pro, an iPhone 16 Pro Max and an 11-inch iPad Pro simultaneously and with the same efficiency as three original chargers (140W + 35W + 35W).

bullets.title: Intelligent charging control
bullets.text: with AnkerSense View, you can monitor the performance in real time on the screen, change modes immediately and activate individual modes via the app via Bluetooth

bullets.title: 2K HD Resolution, Every Moment in View
bullets.text: Experience clear 2K resolution, 351° panoramic view, 60° tilt, 4× zoom — plus split screen to watch two babies at once, day or night. Note: Camera must be plugged in to use.

bullets.title: Hybrid Monitoring, Always in Sight
bullets.text: Never miss a moment with hybrid connection, providing a stable local feed without Wi-Fi, and seamless remote access when you're away. Easily share viewing access with up to 5 family members, keeping everyone connected.Note: Please upgrade the app version to V5.6.0 or above before use.

bullets.title: 12-Hour Battery Power, All-Night Watch
bullets.text: With a 5,000mAh high-capacity battery, enjoy up to 12 hours of screen time on a single charge. Keep your little one under constant, dependable guardian. Note: Battery life is based on internal lab testing and actual performance may vary.

bullets.title: Smart Detection and Alerts, Proactive Protection
bullets.text: An advanced sensing system continually monitors your baby's every kick and roll, cries, room temperature, and unusual noises. Customisable alert settings reduce distractions, ensuring the critical updates while ensuring quick responses when it matters most.

bullets.title: Privacy Protection, Worry-Free Security
bullets.text: Secure and private monitoring with reliable local connection. One-tap Wi-Fi off in the app keeps hackers out. RSA-1024 and AES-128 encryption, with each recording uniquely stored locally. Note: SD card not included. The SD card slot is located underneath the camera lens.

bullets.title: Palm Vein Unlocking
bullets.text: Advanced Security with 99.9% Accuracy. Achieve recognition in just 0.6 seconds with cutting-edge, forgery-proof palm vein recognition. This next-gen security feature relies on the unique vein patterns in your palm, ensuring top-tier protection. Plus, your palm vein data is stored securely on the device, keeping your privacy intact.

bullets.title: This all-in-one device
bullets.text: A 2K HD camera with an f/1.6 lens for sharp, clear visibility — even at night. A video doorbell with a 150° Head-to-Toe wide-angle view that eliminates blind spots, perfect for monitoring packages or checking on visitors. A smart lock with real-time visitor alerts. Whether it's ensuring your family's safety or giving peace of mind when older people or children are home alone, the FamiLock S3 Max keeps you connected and reassured.

bullets.title: The Rear Lock Video Screen
bullets.text: allows you to effortlessly check the front door status anytime, without needing a smartphone app. Its simple, intuitive design makes it ideal for the elderly and children, offering a quick and hassle-free way to see who's at the door. Perfect for households seeking an easy-to-use, app-free solution for monitoring the front entrance.

bullets.title: Dual Power Supply System
bullets.text: Stay powered with a rechargeable battery offering up to 4 months of full functionality, plus an emergency set of 4 AAA batteries for an extra month of essential functionality in case of power outages.

bullets.title: Seamless Home Automation with Matter & Apple Home
bullets.text: Easily integrate with the eufy Ecosystem & HomeBase 3 for advanced AI security features. Supports Matter for smooth, secure connections with Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, and SmartThings — giving you a privacy-first, future-ready smart home experience. [Note: Camera streams are not supported via Matter due to current limitations. For full features and the best experience, please use the eufy App.] Matter is now compatible with HomeBase 3 for simultaneous use. This video lock is not compatible with HomeBase 2.

31483.name: PITAKA Aramid Fiber Magnetic Power Bank (Black/Grey-Twill)

bullets.title: Thinner, Lighter
bullets.text: At just 0.35″ thick and weighing only 4.16oz, the power bank fits easily in your pocket without adding the bulk. No need for an extra bag to carry it, just grab and go!

bullets.title: The Second Battery for Your Phone
bullets.text: This compact power bank packs a powerful 5000mAh battery, keeping your phone juiced up for a full day of basic use. Qi2 certified, it delivers up to 15W of fast wireless charging, allowing you to recharge your device without any hassle on the move.

bullets.title: Better Looks, And Feels
bullets.text: The woven texture of aramid fiber, along with the refined matte metallic finish, offers a pleasant tactile feel in your palm. It creates a harmonious aesthetic when used with a phone case of the same color.

bullets.title: Hassle-Free, Worry-Free
bullets.text: Built-in strong magnets ensure the power bank easily attaches to the back of your phone and stays securely in place on the go.
